items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: There was Duke Holliston, and Duke was playing tenor with this group.

ctx.x: You were how old when you played with them?

I was 14 when I joined that band. And then Paul Gayten put another little group together called Paul Gayten and His Sizzling Six. We had two saxophones. There was Duke Holliston, and Duke was playing tenor with this group. And we had a guitar player, a fine guitar player, who made some marks later on down in Detroit, named Emmett Slade. And we had Paul on piano and Mark Hannah(?) on the drums. And if I remember correctly, there was a boy named Leon Spann who had come up from Piney Woods, Mississippi, with a band…
So we had this little thing. We would play matinees every Monday at the ballrooms... The Crystal Palace was the first one that we played. Our first gig was at the Crystal Palace Ballroom...
